newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong to amend tax law - Tsang.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong to amend tax law - Tsang.

text.p: The Hong Kong government plans a tax law amendment to encourage overseas companies to set up branches in the territory, Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said in his 1997/98 budget speech on Wednesday.

Previously, the Inland Revenue Department had only allowed deductions for foreign withholding tax on income subject to Hong Kong profits tax to Hong Kong-controlled and managed companies, and not to overseas companies operating a branch in Hong Kong.

But because of a judicial decision that foreign withholding tax charged on income or turnover was a legitimate expense regardless of the company's residency status, the Inland Revenue Ordinance would be amended, Tsang said.
